speaker: Doctor
text: The range of motion was limited, and my Phalen's and Tinel's tests returned normal readings. speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Ultrasound shows soft tissue swelling over the radial styloid with hypoechoic fluid collection; no tendon tears or foreign bodies identified.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: De Quervain's Tenosynovitis. The ultrasound confirms soft tissue swelling and fluid at the radial styloid, consistent with inflammation of the first dorsal compartment tendons, especially given your history of pain worsening with gripping.
